    Two-sided tau-data assembly for literal finite-module factor categories #

    The right and left factor meshes are made canonical on surviving selected indecomposables. The remaining declarations identify their nonzero boundaries by restricting the ambient Auslander--Reiten translation and map the ambient mesh isomorphisms through the literal quotient.
